sources.excerpt: Moonbow - Filter + Overdrive Published on November 21, 2024 Land Devices filter high-pass filter low-pass filter overdrive voltage-controlled pedal HPF resonance HPF resonance LPF resonance LPF resonance Information Land Devices OVERVIEW Moonbow is an adaptation of a classic voltage-controlled dual-mode filter paired with a hot-rodded version of the channel strip from our Mixer. The filter is placed in front of the overdrive, for gentle signal compression or bold saturation of its resonant peaks. The flexibility of the gain and level controls allows for use with both instrument level and line level. CONTROLS GAIN: Adjustable from -13dB to +20dB. Turn clockwise to increase gain. LVL: Output volume level. Turn CCW to cut and CW to boost. CUTOFF: Adjusts the frequency range of the filter from 20Hz to 5kHz. RES: Controls the resonance of the filter. Caution should be exercised when pushing past seventy percent. Strong oscillations will occur. HP/LP toggle: Switch between high pass filter & low pass filter. CV IN: Control voltage input for 'CUTOFF.' Accepts 0-5V. sources.excerpt: New Pedal: Land Devices Moonbow Filter + Overdrive | Delicious Audio Creative Pedals Creative Delay Tape Delay W/ Reverb Delay Distortion Fuzz Overdrive Dual Gain Dirt Boost Compr. + Dynamics Dynamics EQ Filter Wah Filter+EQ Lo-Fi 8 Bit Lo-fi Chorus Flanger Phaser Tremolo Uni-Vibe Modulation Pitch Shifter Octaver pitch Multiverb Reverb Spring Reverb Reverb CV In Granular Synth Pedals Synth Effect Guides Monthly Lists Shopping Guides Coverage Schedule Facebook Stompbox Exhibit New Pedal: Land Devices Moonbow Filter + Overdrive Updated Feb. 10, 2025 | by Paolo De Gregorio Filter pedals, when followed by saturation or distortion, can become extremely effective “tone sculptors.” That’s precisely what the Land Devices Moonbow does, opening up a lot of sonic possibilities by elegantly placing an overdrive after a classic voltage-controlled dual-mode filter. The filter is a classic synth-style one, offering both High Pass and Low pass , with selectable Cutoff and Resonance for both modes. It operates on frequencies between 20Hz and 5kHz, and the manufacturer invites to acution when turning the resonance above 70%, due to strong oscillating tendencies. Tthe gain and level controls allow input flexibility, allowing compatibility with both level and line level instruments, but also the introduction of saturated tones, which can create edgy sounds by adding harmonics to the filtered tone.
